scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @orbyn/core && npm run build -w @orbyn/api-client
scripts.dev:packages: npm run dev -w @orbyn/core & npm run dev -w @orbyn/api-client & wait
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck -w backend && npm run typecheck -w desktop && npm run typecheck -w mobile
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w backend
scripts.format: prettier --write "packages/*/src/**/*.ts" backend/src backend/tests desktop/src mobile/src docs README.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check "packages/*/src/**/*.ts" backend/src backend/tests desktop/src mobile/src docs README.md
